title: मधेश विद्रोह र सामाजिक आयाम {Madhes Rebellion and Social Movement}
nepali: वि.सं. २०६३ साल माघ १ गते अन्तरिम संविधान जारी भएको भोलीपल्टदेखि मधेश आन्दोलित भयो । सङ्घीय शासन प्रणाली र जनसङ्ख्याको अनुपातमा समानुपातिक प्रतिनिधित्वको व्यवस्थाको माग र विभेद,वहिष्करण र भेदभावको विरुद्धमा मधेशमा आन्दोलित थियो । मधेश आन्दोलनको केन्द्रमा राजनीतिक बहिष्करण प्रमुखकारण त रहेको थियो तर यसका साथै आन्दोलनका केहि सामाजिक कारणहरु समेत रहेका थिए । विभेद, उत्पिडन,भाषा, रोजगारीका अवसरहरुमा रहेको विभेद, मधेशी प्रति पहाडीया सामाजिक दृष्टिकोण, मधेशको इतिहास माथिकोअबमूल्यन र वहिष्करण लगायतका सामाजिक कारणहरु मधेश आन्दोलन पछाडीका कारणहरु थिए । तसर्थ, यस लेखले मधेश आन्दोलनका सामाजिक कारणहरुको खोजी गर्ने प्रयास गरेको छ ।
american_english: From the day after the interim constitution was promulgated on Magh 1, 2063 BS, Madhes became agitated. There was agitation in Madhes demanding a federal governance system and proportional representation in proportion to population, and against discrimination, exclusion and bias. At the center of the Madhes movement, political exclusion was indeed the main cause, but along with it there were also some social causes of the movement. Discrimination, oppression, language, discrimination in employment opportunities, the social attitude of hill people towards Madhesis, the devaluation of the history of Madhes, and exclusion, among other social causes, were the causes behind the Madhes movement. Therefore, this article has attempted to investigate the social causes of the Madhes movement.

informal_english: From the day after the interim constitution came out on Magh 1, 2063 BS, Madhes got stirred up. There was agitation in Madhes demanding a federal setup and proportional representation in proportion to population, and pushing back against discrimination, exclusion and bias. At the heart of the Madhes movement, political exclusion was really the main cause, but there were also a few social causes behind it as well. Discrimination, oppression, language, discrimination in job opportunities, the way hill people viewed Madhesis, the running down of Madhes's history, and exclusion, among other social causes, were what drove the Madhes movement. So this article has had a crack at investigating the social causes of the Madhes movement.
